scenarios.name: Building cupboards don't know what to buy
scenarios.last_reply:
Love that you're taking on this project! You're in good hands with HDS Group — we have our own factory and 32 branches across South Africa. 

Most of our customers use 16mm White Melamine Chipboard for cupboards as it's durable, clean, and great value. 

Are you building kitchen cupboards, bedroom wardrobes, or something else?

scenarios.name: What boards for kitchen cabinets
scenarios.last_reply:
For kitchen cabinet carcasses (the interior boxes), 16mm White Melamine Chipboard is the industry standard because it's durable, hygienic, and easy to clean. 

For the exterior doors and panels, you can use our decorative melamine boards in wood grain or solid colours. 

What kind of look or colour are you going for with your kitchen doors?
